intro: Excel Professional Detailing & Fiberglass has been making boats look great in the Jacksonville area since 1997. You talk to the team who does the work, from your first call.
servicesIntro: Washing and detailing, plus fiberglass repair, all under one roof.

services.name: Washing & Detailing
services.text: Interior and exterior washing and detailing, waxing, wet sanding, buffing and restoration.

services.name: Cosmetic Fiberglass Repair
services.text: Scratch and blemish removal, plus hole and gouge repair.

services.name: Structural Repairs
services.text: Fiberglass repairs for boats with serious damage.

services.name: Gel Coat Color Matching
services.text: Repairs matched to the color of your boat.

services.name: Graphics & Striping
services.text: Pinstriping and boot striping, plus graphic removal and replacement.

why.name: No middleman
why.text: You speak with the team who will work on your boat from the first call.

why.name: Word of mouth
why.text: Most of our work comes through referrals, and references are available.

why.name: Final check
why.text: We check the work once services are complete, and our estimates are accurate.

howTitle: Back on the water in three steps.

steps.name: Call us
steps.text: Tell us what your boat needs: scratches, gouges, damage or a full detail.

steps.name: Get an estimate
steps.text: We give you an accurate estimate. We work with many area marinas, or you can bring the boat to us.

steps.name: Final check
steps.text: We go over the finished work with you before it leaves.

footerLine: Boat detailing & fiberglass in Jacksonville since 1997
